statement: Pinned Linux hid-wiimote IR input parser sends the four tracked sources' decoded X/Y coordinates as EV_ABS hat pairs, using basic/packed 10-bit coordinate conversion. Its evdev presentation does not expose Dolphin-style extended/full size, intensity or bounding fields, despite the module supporting host IR initialization/report-mode selection. That is a kernel consumer-data loss, not a limitation of raw HID.

applicability.revision: Emulator or Linux/SDL host source behavior; retail revision not measured
applicability.scope: hid-wiimote-modules.c 550-605 coordinate emission and 634-708 IR init/report mode selection.
